name: Dangote Sugar
source: CRON 2026-10-07: group five-year financial summary, printed page 85 of _ngx_pdf/DANGSUGAR.pdf (PDF page 87), read from the GROUP column as at 31 December 2025, in NGN thousands. Net Profit for FY2023, FY2022 and FY2021 was blank; the printed group loss or profit for the year is (73,760,308), 54,742,135 and 22,052,291 thousand. Income Tax is derived for those years as profit before taxation less the printed profit for the year. The stored cells held 4,185,136 thousand, 2 thousand and 3,377,543 thousand, which reconcile to nothing in the group accounts; 4,185,136 and 3,377,543 are the COMPANY income tax of 2025 and 2024 from the statement of value added. Unit: naira (printed NGN thousand x 1,000).

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit, and the column ties with it positive
rows.derivedFormula: Cost of Sales = Revenue - Gross Profit

rows.label: Income Tax
rows.source: Dangote Sugar Refinery Plc audited consolidated statement of profit or loss, year ended 31 December 2025, group column, page 32 (NGN thousands)

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.withhold_reason: withheld: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses does not equal the filed Operating Profit and the file carries no extra line that explains the gap, so the operating expenses (or operating profit) cannot be established from the statement; an honest blank beats a figure that fails its own arithmetic
rows.derivedFormula: Operating Expenses = Gross Profit - Operating Profit (EBIT)

rows.label: Profit Before Tax
rows.source: stockanalysis.com NGX income statement, calibrated to this file's own stored values

rows.label: Net Profit
rows.source: Dangote Sugar Refinery Plc audited consolidated statement of profit or loss, year ended 31 December 2025, group column, page 32 (NGN thousands)

source_note: H1 2026 column from the company filing (https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/47705_DANGOTE_SUGAR_REFINERY_PLC-_QUARTER_2_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2026_FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_JULY_2026.pdf): revenue, profit after tax and EPS only; other lines blank because the release did not state them.
